# Vital Synergy

> Vital Synergy is a building services engineering contractor based in Burnley, Lancashire. We upgrade heating, ventilation and electrical systems in live schools, healthcare, hospitality and commercial buildings, with minimal disruption and one accountable partner from design to maintenance.

## Services

- [Services](https://www.vitalsynergy.co.uk/services.html): mechanical services, low-carbon and renewables, electrical and critical systems, design and consultancy.

## About

- [About](https://www.vitalsynergy.co.uk/about.html): who we are and how we work.
- [Social value](https://www.vitalsynergy.co.uk/social-value.html): our commitments to skills, employability, wellbeing and communities.
- [Careers](https://www.vitalsynergy.co.uk/careers.html): current vacancies.
